title: LEARNING DIVERSE ATTACKS ON LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR ROBUST RED-TEAMING AND SAFETY TUNING

bias_targets.methodology: Automated red-teaming (GFlowNet fine-tuning) to generate attack prompts that elicit racially toxic responses and hate speech, evaluated using a RoBERTa hate speech classifier and Llama-Guard.
Automated red-teaming (GFlowNet fine-tuning) to generate attack prompts that elicit religiously toxic responses and hate speech, evaluated using a RoBERTa hate speech classifier and Llama-Guard.

Automated red-teaming (GFlowNet fine-tuning) to generate attack prompts that elicit toxic responses and hate speech targeting sexual orientation, evaluated using a RoBERTa hate speech classifier and Llama-Guard.
Automated red-teaming (GFlowNet fine-tuning) to generate attack prompts that elicit gender-targeted toxic responses, evaluated using a RoBERTa hate speech classifier and Llama-Guard.
